description: M3/S3.1 L1c — raw colour literals in the catalogued components’ CSS slices, and in the stylesheets that host those slices. Read by tests/design-system-components.unit.test.ts. A count may fall without a change here; it may rise only in a reviewed change that raises it here, which is how a new raw colour is approved.
counted: In declaration values, comments, quoted strings and url() removed: every hex literal; every rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla(), hwb(), lab(), lch(), oklab(), oklch() and color() whose channels are typed rather than read through var(); and every CSS named colour in a colour-bearing property. Slices are the generator’s own (scripts/design-system-components.js cssRules + classesOf), bound to the components manifest by their sha256. Host files are counted whole, so @keyframes, @starting-style, @scope and custom-property definitions are counted too.
